name: ark
description: ARK — AI decision intelligence, AI economics, secure AI operations.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @ark/core && npm run build --workspace @ark/protocols && npm run build --workspace @ark/db && npm run build --workspace @ark/ui && npm run build --workspace @ark/sdk && npm run build --workspace @ark/providers && npm run build --workspace @ark/evals && npm run build --workspace @ark/runtime && npm run build --workspace @ark/guard
scripts.setup: npm run setup:my-ai && npm run build:packages && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @ark/consumer && npm run build --workspace @ark/business && npm run build --workspace @ark/control
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @ark/core && npm run test --workspace @ark/ui && npm run test --workspace @ark/protocols && npm run test --workspace @ark/db && npm run test --workspace @ark/sdk && npm run test --workspace @ark/providers && npm run test --workspace @ark/evals && npm run test --workspace @ark/runtime && npm run test --workspace @ark/guard && npm run test:control && node --test deploy/runtime.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace @ark/consumer && node --experimental-strip-types --test apps/business/src/lib/measure.test.ts apps/business/src/lib/intake-verdict.test.ts apps/business/src/lib/intake-state.test.ts
scripts.test:my-ai: cd my-ai && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest; else python3 -m pytest; fi
